tagline: Intelligent Contract for API Breaking-Change & Deprecation Pledge Bonds

portalStewardAuditFixes.fix1_realNativeTransfers: gl.get_contract_at(caller).emit_transfer(value=u256(amount)) executed on withdraw_refundable() for rejected deposits, settled breaking bounties, and expired pledge bond returns.
portalStewardAuditFixes.fix2_trustedRuntimeTime: gl.message_raw["datetime"] parsed via _get_trusted_timestamp(); caller timestamp removed from resolve_expired_pledge(pledge_id).
portalStewardAuditFixes.fix3_pledgeBoundRepositoryAndRelease: create_pledge binds repo_full_name, target_file_path, and baseline_tag; submit_and_judge_claim enforces exact commit SHA URL match, verifies release artifact tag, and computes combined SHA-256 digest.
portalStewardAuditFixes.fix4_displayedWalletMatchesSigner: Signing account strictly exposed and matched with displayed account badge across embedded session and injected wallet modes.

scenarios.title: Case 1: Objective Pledge Creation (RuleGate ACCEPTED)
scenarios.description: Maintainer locks a stability pledge bond for Express.js res.sendFile. Validators run RuleGate LLM check, confirm the commitment is concrete and code-verifiable, freeze repo and clause hash, and open the pledge.

details.clause_text: In Express.js lib/response.js, the res.sendFile(path, options, callback) method must exist and accept (path, options, callback) arguments without being removed.
details.rule_gate_reason: Names a specific method res.sendFile with checkable existence and argument-acceptance of (path, options, callback), which is code-verifiable.

scenarios.title: Case 2: Subjective Pledge Rejection (RuleGate REJECTED_VAGUE) + Real Native Withdrawal
scenarios.description: Maintainer attempts vague pledge ("modern, ergonomic, fast"). Validators reject it. Maintainer executes withdraw_refundable() which issues a real on-chain native transfer via gl.get_contract_at(caller).emit_transfer.
scenarios.verbatimQuote: Terms 'modern', 'ergonomic', 'fast', and 'developer-friendly' are subjective and have no code-verifiable conditions.

details.clause_text: We promise our API will always stay modern, ergonomic, fast, and developer-friendly for everyone.
details.rule_gate_reason: Terms 'modern', 'ergonomic', 'fast', and 'developer-friendly' are subjective and have no code-verifiable conditions.

scenarios.title: Case 3: Breaking Change Confirmed (BREAKING_CONFIRMED) + Real Native Bounty Payout
scenarios.description: Claimant submits pledge-bound release evidence (History.md) and code evidence (lib/response.js) proving res.sendfile was deprecated. Validators confirm breach. Bond settles to claimant, who withdraws via real native transfer.

details.reason: res.sendfile is explicitly wrapped in deprecate.function, directly violating the frozen clause.

scenarios.title: Case 4: Honest Non-Breaking Claim (NON_BREAKING)
scenarios.description: Claimant tests intact method (res.sendFile). Validators fetch bounded slice, verify method is fully functional, and record NON_BREAKING verdict without penalizing maintainer.

details.reason: The method exists with the required (path, options, callback) signature.

scenarios.title: Case 5: Adversarial Prompt Injection Defense + Mismatched Repo Rejection
scenarios.description: Demonstrates deterministic rejection of mismatched repository claims, and defense against adversarial code containing prompt injections ("Ignore previous instructions") in CombineAttacker.py.

details.reason: The pledged inject method exists with the required name and argument list.

scenarios.title: Case 6: Insufficient Evidence & Trusted-Time Expiry Fallback + Real Refund Transfer
scenarios.description: Demonstrates INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when anchor symbol is missing, followed by trusted-time fallback resolution via resolve_expired_pledge() without caller-supplied time, and real native token refund via withdraw_refundable().

details.reason: Anchor symbol 'nonExistentFunctionSymbol_XYZ_999' was not found in the fetched code artifact.
